Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Are there any cards which only affect (or require)
"Non-Camarilla" vampires, which also mean "Non-Sabbat"?
It seems that alot of cards were intended to only
affect the Independents, but they didn't have a word for
it yet. I was wondering if there was any errata to that
effect, or if I am to assume that all cards which say
"Requires a Non-Camarilla Vampire" can require a Sabbat
vamp as well.

Thanks.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> writes:

> Are there any cards which only affect (or require)
> "Non-Camarilla" vampires, which also mean "Non-Sabbat"?

No.

Non-Camarilla means "Not a member of the Camarilla" i.e. independent
or Sabbat.

There are no cards which require *only* independent vampires. (And
are not, say, Setite only or whatever.)

> It seems that alot of cards were intended to only
> affect the Independents, but they didn't have a word for
> it yet.

True. However, this was known when the Sabbat was designed and
released, and it's not been a major problem.

> I was wondering if there was any errata to that
> effect, or if I am to assume that all cards which say
> "Requires a Non-Camarilla Vampire" can require a Sabbat
> vamp as well.

You are.

However, it is theoretically possible that Final Nights will contain
"Requires an Independent vampire" type cards.

No errata to that effect.

> "Requires a Non-Camarilla Vampire" can require a Sabbat
> vamp as well.

It doesn't require a Sabbat vampire, but a Sabbat vampire
would meet the "Non-Camarilla" requirement.

Any card that means "Non-Camarilla and Non-Sabbat" would
say "Independent" instead.
